card.name: Unit words after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word right after a number or hyphenated number, such as -fold, -hour, -Minute or /minute. It is mostly in infusion rates, dialysis times and exposure increases.

modes.label: Time unit after number
modes.description: Minute, hour or time directly after a number in infusion or dialysis durations and rates.
modes.example: Table 3: Kyprolis 20/27 mg/m 2 Twice Weekly (10-Min<<ute>> Infusion) Cycle 1 Week

modes.label: Fold increase
modes.description: The word fold after a hyphenated number describing an increase in exposure.
modes.example: P-gp Substrates Concomitant use of EPIDIOLEX with orally administered everolimus results in an approximately 2.5‑<<fold>> increase in plasma exposures of everolimus
